method: Traverse reachable instruction positions and decode actual PC-relative literal operands, including delay slots.
Require identical function extents, CFG instruction positions and literal positions.
Every changed byte must lie within a decoded 32-bit literal slot; opcode and all other constant bytes must be identical.
Each changed pointer retains a matching exact typed symbol/interior role, or references an identical bounded caption. Duplicate local helpers use qualified ELF records.

Two anonymous authored constants are recognized by complete content: the six-halfword patch template, and four ordered immutable caption pointers SUB/END/FREE/STORE. No arbitrary RAM-looking literal is normalized.
All 62 prepared-body/typed-relocation signatures remain identical, including the complete immutable constant section.
